description: This file contains utility functions used internally by the Leaflet mapping library, including object manipulation, function binding, ID stamping, throttling, number wrapping, string trimming, templating, and request animation frame handling.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Merges properties from source objects into a destination object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new object with the specified prototype, polyfilled if native Object.create is unavailable.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Returns a function bound to a specific context and arguments, similar to Function.prototype.bind.

methods.name: stamp
methods.description: Assigns or retrieves a unique ID for an object.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Returns a throttled version of a function that executes at most once per specified time interval.

methods.name: wrapNum
methods.description: Returns a number wrapped within a specified range, with optional inclusion of the maximum value.

methods.name: falseFn
methods.description: Returns a function that always returns false.

methods.name: formatNum
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string, polyfilled if String.prototype.trim is unavailable.

methods.name: splitWords
methods.description: Splits a trimmed string into an array of words based on whitespace.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Merges options into an object's options property, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getParamString
methods.description: Converts an object into a URL parameter string, optionally appending to an existing URL and uppercasing parameter names.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Performs simple string templating by replacing placeholders with data values or evaluated functions.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is an array, polyfilled if Array.isArray is unavailable.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of an element in an array, polyfilled if Array.prototype.indexOf is unavailable.

methods.name: requestAnimFrame
methods.description: Schedules a function to run on the next repaint, with fallbacks for older browsers.

methods.name: cancelAnimFrame
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled animation frame callback.

search-terms: polyfills for array and object methods
